clips.title: A Girl Who Exists Only in Memory
grammar: 〜はずだ — should be / supposed to be

lines.ja: 記憶の中にしか存在しないはずの彼女が、突然、目の前に現れた。
lines.en: She, who was only supposed to exist in my memories, suddenly appeared before me.
lines.speaker: Chihiro

lines.ja: 幼馴染のこと、忘れちゃった？
lines.en: Did you forget about your childhood friend?
lines.speaker: Toka

lines.ja: 君は偽の記憶の中の人だ。
lines.en: You're a person from a fake memory.
lines.speaker: Chihiro

clips.title: The Words I Wanted to Hear

lines.ja: でも、思い出があふれて止まらへんのやろ？
lines.en: Still, memories keep flooding back and won't stop, right?
lines.speaker: Friend

lines.ja: そんなら、その子に騙されてみれば？
lines.en: Then why don't you just let yourself be tricked by her?
lines.speaker: Friend

lines.ja: 泣くなって。そばにいるから。
lines.en: Don't cry. I'm right here beside you.
lines.speaker: Chihiro

lines.ja: 私が欲しい言葉、分かっちゃうんだね。
lines.en: You know exactly the words I want to hear, don't you?
lines.speaker: Toka
